user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Web pages crawled for ChatGPT search features.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web pages crawled to train generative AI foundation models.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited when users ask questions or interact with GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Excludes future site materials from AI model training datasets when restricted.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Prevents retrieving content for user queries, reducing visibility in user-directed web search.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.scope: Prevents indexing content for search optimization, reducing search result visibility.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and related search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search image features.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google News, including news.google.com and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools; no effect on Google Search.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler used by product teams for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Fetches publicly accessible content; does not affect any specific product.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetches publicly accessible images; does not affect any specific product.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetches publicly accessible videos; does not affect any specific product.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects training and grounding for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically to improve search.
user_agents.scope: Web content and indexing

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: Web content fetched upon user request

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and collects data for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web crawl data for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls usage of crawled data for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls data usage for Apple general purpose foundation models powering generative AI features.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews and information.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed to enhance relevance, accuracy, and citations in Meta AI.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for advertising and other business products and services.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for training foundation AI models and indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models or improving products.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual user-requested links and AI web navigation for completing tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content for Bing Chat and Microsoft Copilot features
user_agents.scope: Bing Chat, Microsoft Copilot, and related generative AI services

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Standard web crawler powering Bing search and downstream AI services
user_agents.scope: Bing search index and Microsoft AI experiences

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Host-level web crawling to improve services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or noarchive, noindex, and none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences across Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Content indexing for Amazon search experiences without generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives or noindex and none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live web information for queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live fetching; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions may not follow all robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to build an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls a sample of the web via HTTP GET requests without executing JavaScript.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: CCBot Disallow: / to robots.txt or join the opt-out registry.
